documents.text:
HOSPITAL COURSE: Treated for urosepsis. Urine culture grew E. coli sensitive to ceftriaxone. Lactate normalized after fluids.
PLAN: Oral cefpodoxime to complete 10 days. Primary care follow-up.

documents.author: Dr. O. Bruce
documents.title: Primary Care Visit
documents.text:
SUBJECTIVE: Mx. Sanchez, a 34-year-old patient, is seen for routine care. No chest pain.
OBJECTIVE: LDL 130 mg/dL on the latest lipid panel.
ASSESSMENT: Hyperlipidemia above goal in a patient with diabetes.
PLAN: Start atorvastatin 40 mg nightly. Recheck lipids in 12 weeks.

documents.author: Dr. N. Vaughn
documents.title: Endocrinology Follow-up
documents.text:
SUBJECTIVE: Mx. Sanchez, a 34-year-old patient, presents for diabetes follow-up. Reports polyuria and fatigue. Adherent to metformin 1000 mg twice daily.
OBJECTIVE: HbA1c 8.4% today, up from 7.6% at the prior visit. Fasting glucose 208 mg/dL.
ASSESSMENT: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with worsening glycemic control.
PLAN: Add empagliflozin 10 mg daily. Diabetes education referral. Repeat HbA1c in 3 months.

documents.author: Dr. G. Kidd
documents.title: Ophthalmology Consult
documents.text:
REASON: Diabetic eye screening.
FINDINGS: Mild nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy in both eyes. No macular edema.
PLAN: Repeat dilated exam in 12 months.

documents.author: Dr. P. Rodriguez
documents.title: Discharge Summary
documents.text:
HOSPITAL COURSE: A 25-year-old man was admitted with dyspnea, orthopnea and leg edema. BNP was 885 pg/mL. Diuresed with IV furosemide with 4 kg net weight loss. Sodium 133 mmol/L on admission.
ASSESSMENT: Acute on chronic systolic heart failure.
PLAN: Furosemide 40 mg daily, carvedilol 6.25 mg twice daily. Daily weights, 2 g sodium diet. Cardiology follow-up in 1 week.

documents.author: Dr. V. Foster
documents.title: Admission History and Physical
documents.text:
HPI: A 64-year-old woman reports 4 days of productive cough, fever to 38.4 C and pleuritic chest pain.
LABS: WBC 18.1 x10^3/uL.
ASSESSMENT: Community-acquired pneumonia, CURB-65 score 2.
PLAN: Ceftriaxone and azithromycin. Blood cultures pending.

documents.author: Dr. A. Knight
documents.title: Discharge Summary
documents.text:
HOSPITAL COURSE: Treated for right lower lobe pneumonia with IV antibiotics. Afebrile for 48 hours before discharge.
PLAN: Complete 5 days of oral amoxicillin-clavulanate. Repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks.

documents.author: Dr. V. Osborne
documents.title: Nephrology Consult
documents.text:
REASON: Rising creatinine and high potassium.
FINDINGS: A 26-year-old man has creatinine 2.61 mg/dL, potassium 5.8 mmol/L and estimated GFR 37 mL/min/1.73m2.
ASSESSMENT: Chronic kidney disease stage 3b with hyperkalemia.
PLAN: Stop lisinopril. Start sodium zirconium cyclosilicate. Low potassium diet. Repeat BMP in 1 week.

documents.author: Dr. J. Parsons
documents.title: ED Provider Note
documents.text:
HPI: A 67-year-old woman presents with sudden shortness of breath and pleuritic chest pain after a long flight.
EXAM: Heart rate 115 bpm, SpO2 89% on room air.
LABS: Troponin I 0.112 ng/mL.
ASSESSMENT: Suspected pulmonary embolism. CT angiography ordered.
PLAN: Start heparin infusion. Admit to telemetry.

documents.author: Dr. H. Lawson
documents.title: Discharge Summary
documents.text:
HOSPITAL COURSE: Admitted for acute pulmonary embolism. Transitioned from heparin to apixaban. Oxygen weaned to room air.
PLAN: Apixaban 10 mg twice daily for 7 days then 5 mg twice daily. Hematology follow-up.

documents.author: Dr. L. Robinson
documents.title: Primary Care Visit
documents.text:
SUBJECTIVE: A 50-year-old man reports fatigue, cold intolerance and weight gain over 6 months.
OBJECTIVE: TSH 13.96 mIU/L, free T4 0.71 ng/dL.
ASSESSMENT: Primary hypothyroidism.
PLAN: Start levothyroxine 50 mcg daily. Recheck TSH in 6 weeks.

documents.author: Dr. V. Campos
documents.title: Admission History and Physical
documents.text:
HPI: A 29-year-old woman with known COPD presents with increased dyspnea and sputum for 3 days.
EXAM: SpO2 90% on room air, diffuse expiratory wheezes.
ASSESSMENT: Acute exacerbation of COPD.
PLAN: Nebulized albuterol and ipratropium, prednisone 40 mg daily, doxycycline.

documents.author: Dr. B. Riley
documents.title: Neurology Consult
documents.text:
HPI: A 34-year-old woman developed acute right arm weakness and expressive aphasia.
EXAM: NIHSS 7.
LABS: LDL 168 mg/dL.
ASSESSMENT: Acute ischemic stroke, left MCA territory.
PLAN: Aspirin and high-intensity atorvastatin. Telemetry to evaluate for atrial fibrillation.

documents.author: Dr. X. Anderson
documents.title: ED Provider Note
documents.text:
HPI: A 51-year-old man presents with fever, confusion and dysuria.
EXAM: Temperature 38.9 C, mean arterial pressure 64 mmHg.
LABS: Lactate 4 mmol/L, WBC 22 x10^3/uL.
ASSESSMENT: Sepsis from a urinary source.
PLAN: 30 mL/kg crystalloid bolus, blood and urine cultures, piperacillin-tazobactam. Admit to step-down unit.
